record.issue_text: Serializer exposes only `category_id` while the client reconstructs `host.category` ad-hoc via `Discourse.Category.findById`, leaving an implicit contract for external consumers of `/admin/embeddable_hosts`

adjudication.rationale: In the diff, `EmbeddableHostSerializer` only returns `:id, :host, :category_id` (no `category` relationship), and the Ember component explicitly patches the in-memory model after save: `host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId')))` (admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6). That means consumers of the `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController` create/update JSON cannot rely on a `category` object being returned and must reconstruct it from `category_id` (as the UI does), which is a concrete API/contract/design concern rather than a provable functional bug in this diff.
